units.source_text: 源氏内大臣回到二条院，便将此事告知紫姬：

en.t: When Minister Genji returned to the Nijo estate, he told Lady Murasaki about the matter:

units.source_text: “我想把前斋宫迎接到这里来，你和她两人共话，倒是很好的一对伴侣。”

en.t: I would like to invite the former Saiin here. If you and she could talk together, the two of you would make very good companions.

units.source_text: 紫姬很高兴，连忙准备迎接。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was very pleased and quickly began preparing to receive her.
